contents: 0.1.56 plus wave 3 (#213) and the version bump; learner-model codes (#217) are not included
wave3: streamed companion replies: a draft marked 'not checked yet' replaced by the stored reply; 'Stop this reply'; streamed cut-short and refusal handling
AI services: a 'Run check' button for each job that needs a quality check, also flagged on the course overview; jobs are never turned off automatically
per-learner spending: a limit per learner or an explicit 'No limit per learner' (the workspace total still applies); a 'What learners spend' panel; budget changes audited

moving learners to a newer course version: byte-identical checkpoints carry over; learners with personal changes are offered the move; forced moves need a reason, are audited and archive personal changes
in-app notifications: a staff bell and a learner bell; nothing is sent by email
admin forms keep edits across reloads and name a version saved elsewhere instead of saving over it
Hebrew glossary: the tutor is המנחה in the learner app; the staff-facing supervisor is המפקח (admin only)
courses built with SDK 0.4 are refused when installed as packages

statusByStage.tested: Core CI on each PR and on main; release run 13/13 jobs; before publication the course's released-consumer acceptance (course 0.1.4, 0.1.6 and 0.1.7 harnesses), a migration and reconcile rehearsal on a copy of the pilot database, wave 3 feature checks in a real browser (Chromium and WebKit, en/he, desktop and phone) and an upgrade drill with a snapshots entry in the config, all against the candidate bytes with scripted models, fake keys and local stubs
statusByStage.released: v0.1.57 GitHub prerelease (2026-10-24T22:24:13Z); hosted assets byte-identical to the candidate (8 of 8); SHA256SUMS 6/6; gh attestation verify 8/8
statusByStage.deployed: the local pilot upgraded 0.1.56 -> 0.1.57 with deploy/local/upgrade.mjs of 0.1.57
statusByStage.liveVerified: pilot health, processes, migrations, the per-learner default ($25, limit mode), unchanged ledger, scheduled snapshots and a restore drill of the first 0.1.57 snapshot, pilot acceptance (QA learner on phone, tablet, desktop; no answers submitted) and a signed-out tailnet check; no live provider call

qualificationBeforePublication.migrationRehearsal: exactly 115, 117, 118 and 120, none on a second run; the 98 old migration digests, 880 rows in 190 old tables (except backup reports written by the drill), pins, 4 role bindings and AI setup rows unchanged; additions: 4 tables (carried_checkpoint_attempts, course_version_move_offers, notifications, personal_change_archives) and 2 columns; backup and restore drill 191 tables / 978 rows
qualificationBeforePublication.budgetsRehearsal: per-learner default $25, revision 2, mode 'limit'; the new column's default is 'unset' (never 'unlimited')
qualificationBeforePublication.reconcileRehearsal: two passes settled nothing; ledger unchanged (21,079 micro-USD charged, 0 uncertain, nothing held); no provider reachable
qualificationBeforePublication.featureChecks: streamed replies (first sentence about 0.34 s after Send; stop, cancel, cut-short and withdrawn refusal; ledger reconciled), per-job and full quality checks (9/9 and 13/13), staff and learner bells, no limit per learner with the workspace total still enforced, admin forms across tabs, version move with carry-over, offers and an audited forced move, Hebrew glossary and en-XA scans
qualificationBeforePublication.upgradeDrill: with a snapshots entry in the config: a forced restore-drill failure restarted 0.1.56; a normal upgrade succeeded (102 migrations, 195 tables) and kept the snapshots entry
findings: for up to about 30 s while a reply streams, the learner app shows 'Stop waiting'/'Cancel and ask again' instead of 'Stop this reply' (same cancel route; cosmetic)
a question shown as 'Queued' may already be with the provider (dispatched about 70 ms after saving)
a learner held by the workspace limit sees only 'Still working on your last question', with no notice that the limit was reached
'Save prices' fails with a generic message (PROVIDER_PRICING_EFFECTIVE_DATE_INVALID) when a later price is already scheduled; probably older than wave 3
staff notification conditions are re-read at most every 30 s per person (by design)

Neither stop fired.
